        id = "92110a87-66b4-5fc5-b3f5-3e59ec2671b2"
    strings:
        $r1 = "StarBasic"
        $r2 = "</script:module>"
        $s1 = "Shell" nocase
        $s2 = ".Run" nocase
        $s3 = ".PutInClipboard" nocase
        $s4 = "powershell" nocase

        $fp1 = "LibreOffice project" ascii
    condition:
        filesize < 1MB
        and uint32be(0) == 0x3c3f786d // <?xm
        and all of ($r*)
        and 1 of ($s*)
        and not 1 of ($fp*)
}
